book.name: Nzaelwapxngr
book.title: Nzaelwapx-krbz Jiszs Mz Jon Da Kcng Tqyc-kapq-pnzng

content: Da Kxmrlzting Ngr Jerusalem Kxmrna
Mz nibr nzmc-krnge Jerusalem kxmrna, aelwapx-kz-ngrm enjrl kc bange Lue ngr Nzlungr yrlelzm mz tron nyz Gct ncdr Nei Sip, x nzopx-krde apule dzpq.

Yrlekiole vau r lrpzki kc tqtavau Mzteadau, x nrlarde rlilrdr tungr Nounc ngr Nzlungr. X nzpa-krdr nzwrde nzpnu-esz'-nrade-li (12) mz yiz kxesz', nzwrde esz' mz temz kxesz'. X leu rdrng ngi dalr nzrkatxngr zyagox ngr nrkrdrtq leplz kxnztubqng ngr mztea amrlx.
A' trpengr nzayrplapxngr kc tqyrlq pnz Gct, tqakipxle nide x leplz. A' Gct ncdr Nei Sip nawxbuomqng mz tron nyzdr Mzteadau. X kxnzawz nedrng amrlx na-angiolr nidr elr.
Mzli kc trpnzngr doa kx mcle Gct. A' mzli lcpe krkcng tzyrtrpz drtq Gct mz rtrlrmztr, sc tzmctr-atepebzlr mzte, x sc tzkrlz-angidrpe-kzlr nide.

Trpnzngr nrlckxbq mrlcde, x trnzsutiu drtwrdr zyzlr ngr nepi o lam, murde Kxetu Gct sa nayzlrpx-ngrbz badr. X leplz lcng sa nanginipe-kzdr king x nzaclve-krdr tqvzpe tqvzpe. X da kx mc-rmnr-ngrbo nide lape.
Natq Enjrl X Natq Jiszs

Zbz rpi-mop enjrl kc bange kx, “Natq lcng da angidr x takitrde nzabrkitr drtwr. X Kxetu rgu, Gct kc tqkabzle Mqngrde mz profet kcng bqnc, atwzlr-ngrmle ninge nzaelwapx-krbo mz kxnzawz nedeng amrlx da lcng tqycpe pipz nzprtz-krdr.”

Rpim Jiszs bagu kx, “Lalztq-angidramu, murde mzli trnaboiu x ninge kc tqyzlupe-mopwc'. X sa namrlzbz mz doa kcng tzyrlq-angidrlr natq kcng tqkapx Gct mz Buk lc, murde sa nakrlz-angidrlr da lcng amrlx mzli kc tqycpe pipz nzprtz-krdr.”
Ninge Jon. Xlrx x mcx da lcng amrlx tqaelwa-ngrm enjrl kc bange. X kx yrkrpxbz kc nzxlr-krnge x nzrmc-krnge da lcng, ninge kc tqrweopebo zpr bade mz nzangio-krngele.
A' rpi-mople bange kx, “Bzkq! Angio txpwz Gct! Murde wztr-kzpo mz Gct, da kc tqwaiamu badr profet x leplz amrlx kcng tzyrlq-angidrlr natq kcng tqyclzm mz Buk lc.
Bzkq yrlq-kapqq natq kcng tqpipx Gct mz Buk lc, murde ycpe pipz nzkaputr-krmqng.

Mz nzmu-krde lcde, mzli r leplz nztekqtr-krdr nqmq krdrng sc tqyrkrpxpe. X mzli ka, kxnzvz-rbrng sa navz zvz mz nzvz-rbr-krdr, x kxdrka'-ngrng sa navz zvz nzale-krdr da kxdrka'ngr. A' kxnztrng sa navz zvz mz nztr-krdr, x kxnztubqng sa navz zvz nzale-krdr da kxtubq.”

Rpi-mop Jiszs kx, “Ninge Jiszs. Lalztq-angidrmamu, murde mzli trnzboi-krdeu x ninge kc tqyzlupe-mopwc'. X sa natwzmc da kx nayrlq-ngrbo mq leplz amrlx, navz-nqblqle nzwz-krdrng, kxmule-esz' kxmrlz o kxtrka.”
Ninge nou da amrlx x kx ayrkrpx da amrlx. X ninge kxrtwayz x kxrmnr-ngrbz. X ninge kz kx ryzutr da amrlx x kx amrbrtx mou.”
Ninge Jon. Namrlzbz mz doa kcng lrpzdr tqprki mz nztapzo-krdrleng mz mepyr ngr Jiszs, murde takitrde nidr nzprtr-krdr mz naonrx ngr Mzteadau x nzmu-krdr nra Nounc ngr Nzlungr.

A' kzdung kz leplz kcng tzvz-nqblqlr nzmncngr kxtrka, trtxpnzngr nzvztr-krdr Mzteadau. Leplz kxnzmulr seng: kxnzryzplengz-ngrng, kxnzrmwiming doa kx trngiu krnalzdr, kxnzrnibqng, kxnzangiolr mqngr drka' kxnzlz, x kxnzmrlzbz badr nzpokia-zvzngr.

“Ninge Jiszs. Ninge lc tqatwzlr-ngrbo enjrl nenge bamu mz nzpipx-krbzle da lcng bamu, nimu kxnzrlxngiting mz makxtr kcng rlimz. Vzpx-angidrmc mz nqvi lr melrmqnge King Devet. X apux Paglxnrlc, mz nzaelwapx-krnge Zbq Kxmrna ngr Gct.”
Mqngrkxtr ncdr Olvz R Nei Sip nzrpibzlr bade kx, “Vzm!” X nekeng amrlx nzxlrlr natqde narpi-kzlr kx, “Vzm, kx Kxetu Jiszs!” Neke drtwrde brlxkz navzm, murde narmnq Lue ngr Nzlungr kx nzrka-nrbalq.
Aclvetioamu!

Ninge Jon. Aclvetioamu nimu kcng tzxlrlr natq Gct kcng tqkapxle tqyclzm mz buk lc, murde namwxlrtiamu. Murde doa kx ryrlqtr-mopwz kzdung natq kxnzpokiangr mz natq kcng tqyclzpem mz buk lc, sa na-ayrplapx Gct mz nzayrplapxngr kxtrka kcng tqpipxpele mz buk lc.

X doa kx katxpxle kzdung natq mz natq lcng tqkapx Gct tqyclzm mz buk lc, trpnzngr nzmncpx-krmle Mzteadau kxtr, x trpnzngr nzmu-krde nra Nounc ngr Nzlungr, mz nzkatxpxkr Gct da kxmrlzting kcng tqycmnetrngr buk lc.
Vzm Kxetu Jiszs
Jiszs kc tqycmnetr-ngrde da lcng amrlx rpile kx, “Da zpwxtx! Mzli trnzboi-krdeu x ninge kc tqyzlupe-mopwc'.” X kxnzrlxngiting amrlx nzrpibzlr bade kx, “Eu, angida! Vz-anim, kx Kxetu Jiszs!”
X ninge Jon krka'-ngrne kx Kxetu Jiszs naokatrle leplz kxnztrng nedeng amrlx mz zmrlz ngrde kxmyalz. Eu, angida!
